name: USA People Search
instructions: Open https://www.usa-people-search.com/removal and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks for an email address, so the reply is matched. Then press "I've done this".
notes: A two-form flow: first a search, then a removal form for the chosen record.
source: Process per redact.dev's USA People Search removal guide (May 2026).
